name: 89115 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89115 (Las Vegas) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89115 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89115 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
